title: Pull-back by the coordinate map of an orthonormal frame preserves the Euclidean coefficient norm (part (b))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let v = (v_0, …, v_{n−1}) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P = Euclid P, and let pL : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ be a continuous linear map with (pL x)_i = ⟨v_i, x⟩ for all x ∈ ℝ^P and i ∈ Fin n. Let l ∈ ℕ and let γ be an l-covector on ℝⁿ (Covector (Euclid n) l). Then the pulled-back covector γ∘pL = γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL, (γ∘pL)(u_1, …, u_l) = γ(pL u_1, …, pL u_l), satisfies |γ∘pL|_E = |γ|_E. Here |·|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm on Covector (Euclid P) l and on Covector (Euclid n) l respectively.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid n), Orthonormal ℝ v → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (i : Fin n), pL x i = inner ℝ (v i) x) → ∀ (l : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Euclid n) l), covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) = covectorEuclideanNorm γ
